item.title: Kuwait declares force majeure, cuts crude oil output due to Middle East conflict
item.description: (Reuters): Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) began cutting oil output on Saturday and declared force majeure, adding to earlier oil and gas reductions from Iraq and Qatar as the US-Iran war blocked shipments from the Middle East ​for the eighth consecutive day. item.title: Explosion at US embassy in Oslo, no injuries
item.description: OSLO (AFP) : The US embassy in Oslo was hit by an explosion in the early hours of Sunday but no one was injured, police in the Norwegian capital said, adding the cause was not immediately known.
